findings.asked: Mean and SD of a grouped frequency distribution.
findings.wentWrong: Mean fine; in the SD many squared the fx column rather than computing f x squared, and arithmetic slips were common.
findings.rule: The SD column is f times x squared, not (fx) squared.

findings.asked: Estimate mean and SD from grouped data.
findings.wentWrong: Some squared the sum of the fx column; arithmetic errors.
findings.rule: Compute sum fx and sum f x squared separately.

findings.asked: Mean and SD from a table of daily values.
findings.wentWrong: Some treated the table as grouped data and invented midpoints, or numbered the days 1 to 5; a sum was put into the formula in the wrong place; some scored nothing.
findings.rule: Identify whether the data are raw values or frequencies before choosing the formula.

findings.asked: Binomial probabilities with a simple final part.
findings.rule: Give probabilities to 2 d.p. (or as instructed) without truncating.

ruleToRemember: Mean = sum fx / sum f; SD from sum f x squared / sum f minus mean squared, then square root; check whether the table holds raw values or frequencies; keep full precision until the final rounding.
